newsitem.title: UK: EMI down amid fresh music sales worries.
newsitem.headline: EMI down amid fresh music sales worries.

text.p: Shares in music publisher EMI Group Plc dropped on Tuesday as a report in the Financial Times raised fresh concerns about sluggish music sales, traders said.
The stock was down 15-1/2p at 12.01 stg by 0903 GMT, after earlier dropping as low as 12.00 stg -- equalling its low since the demerger of the Thorn retail business earlier this year.

The FT report said the music industry faced static sales in 1996 after several years of double-digit growth, and that a prolonged slowdown could post serious financial problems for the small group of companies that dominate the world music market.
EMI shares have come under pressure since the Thorn demerger as a takeover bid failed to materialise and sales worries grew with rival PolyGram last month issuing a profit warning.
